description: This header file defines the `absl::Status` class and related enumerations, functions, and utilities for error handling within the Abseil C++ library. It includes definitions for status codes, payload management, and error creation functions, serving as a core component for error reporting and propagation.

classes.name: absl::Status
classes.description: Represents the success or error state of an operation, encapsulating error codes, messages, and payloads for error context.

methods.name: absl::Status::ok
methods.description: Checks if the status indicates success (no error).

methods.name: absl::Status::ToString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the status, including code, message, and payloads based on the mode.

methods.name: absl::Status::SetPayload
methods.description: Attaches additional contextual data to the status with a type URL key.

methods.name: absl::Status::GetPayload
methods.description: Retrieves the payload associated with a specific type URL key.

methods.name: absl::Status::Update
methods.description: Updates the status with a new status if the current status is OK.

methods.name: absl::Status::ErasePayload
methods.description: Removes the payload associated with a specific type URL key.

methods.name: absl::Status::ForEachPayload
methods.description: Iterates over all payloads, calling a visitor function for each.

methods.name: absl::OkStatus
methods.description: Returns a default OK status indicating success.

methods.name: absl::CancelledError
methods.description: Creates a status representing a cancelled operation.

methods.name: absl::ErrnoToStatusCode
methods.description: Maps an errno value to a corresponding StatusCode.

methods.name: absl::ErrnoToStatus
methods.description: Creates a Status object from an errno value and message.
